app.name: Stormfire
app.long_description:
Keep the campfire burning. Enemies march in from every side of the forest; build and upgrade four kinds of towers on the walls and blocks to stop them.
Level 1, The Storm: a night of rain and lightning, ending with the Storm Golem. Level 2, Autumn Gold: golden hour in an autumn forest with armoured beetles, splitting slimes, sprinting foxes, crows and the Pumpkin King. Level 3, Hallows Eve: a foggy Halloween dusk where zombies and gravebreakers smash your towers, ghosts fade out of reach, skeletons get back up, and the Ghoul King rises. Level 4, Dawn Isle: an island of old machines at sunrise - the sun climbs as the waves go by - with clockwork automatons, leaping springers, shielding brass moths, repairing tinkers, tower-smashing sentinels and the Architect.
Every level has its own music.
Choose a level on the title screen with left / right.
Controls (Classic Controller): Left stick / D-Pad: move the cursor A: build / upgrade B: sell L / R: choose tower Y: fast forward X: call the next wave early (bonus gold) +: pause (music / sound on-off, restart, quit) -: 16:9 / 4:3 screen HOME: exit
